sentences.text: The report categorically state that the complaint which is lodged and resulted into registration of C.R.No.306 of 2017 by invoking Section 420, 120 B of Indian Penal Code (IPC) along-with the Copyright Act, 1957, alongwith the various provisions of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, is wrongly registered, and, therefore in the wake of the power available under Section 157(1)(b) of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Cr.P.C.) and the provision contained in Maharashtra Police Manual Part 3 Rule 123, where the investigation can be stopped for an offence which is wrongly registered, it is declared that the investigation in the subject CR is closed.

As regards the observations of this Court attributing dereliction on part of certain police offcers, the Special IG by his order dated 15th April, 2024 has already ordered initiation of departmental inquiry against the concerned offcers who are found to be at fault.

2 In the wake of aforesaid statement, the petition deserve a disposal, however, since the proxy counsel informed that Mr.Kamat is not available, at this stage when the matter is Rajeshri Aher 3/3 6 wp 2431 of 2017.doc
